essay.mr: नाम म्हणजे भगवंतापर्यंत पोंचण्याचें केवळ साधन नव्हे. नाम हा जीव आणि शिव यांमधील दुवा आहे{{3}} — या एका वाक्यानें पुढचें सगळें बदलून जातें.
essay.en: नाम — the Name — is not a technique for reaching God. It is the link itself{{3}}. That one claim rearranges everything that follows.

essay.mr: दुवाच जर नाम आहे, तर तें वाटेवरचें कांहीं नाहीं. नाम हें साध्य आहे व साधनहि आहे{{4}}. म्हणून पुढें पोंचण्यासारखें दुसरें कांहीं उरत नाहीं.
essay.en: If the Name is the bridge between you and God, it is not something you do on the way to somewhere else. It is both the goal and the means{{4}} — साध्य आणि साधन — at once. There is nothing further to arrive at.

essay.mr: रूप डोळ्यांपुढें आणतां आलें पाहिजे, असेंहि नाहीं. निराकार सगुणांत आला तेव्हां त्याला नाम-रूप लागलें; सगुणरूप नाहींसें झालें तरी नाम शिल्लकच राहिलें{{7}}. म्हणून सगुण भक्तालाहि आणि निर्गुण भक्तालाहि आधार तोच. आणि हा दुवा नव्यानें बांधावा लागत नाहीं — नाम ही आपली वृत्ति आणि भगवंत यांना जोडणारी सांखळीच आहे{{11}}; ती आपण उचललेली नसते, एवढेंच.
essay.en: Nor does it depend on your being able to picture anything. The Name arose when the formless took form; when the form dissolved, the Name remained{{7}}. So it holds for the devotee who needs an image and equally for the one who needs none. And it is not a rope you must throw across a gap — it is a chain already joining you to Him{{11}}, which you have simply not picked up.

essay.mr: इथेंच बहुतेकजण थांबतात — आधीं कांहीं वाटलें पाहिजे, अशी वाट पाहत. हें पान तें कारण अगदीं साध्या उदाहरणानें काढून टाकतें.
essay.en: Here is where most of us stop: waiting to feel something first. This page removes that excuse with an entirely ordinary comparison.

essay.mr: अन्नाला स्वतःची चव असते; आपण आपली गोडी घालून मग तें खातों. नामाला स्वतःची अशी चव नाहीं{{13}}. त्यांतली गोडी आपणच घातलेली असते — आणि जितकी घालूं तितकी ती वाढते. म्हणून जी ओढ आपण वाट पाहत होतों, ती आधीं येणारी नव्हतीच. ती नंतर येते.
essay.en: Food arrives with a taste of its own; you bring your liking to it and then you eat. The Name has no taste of its own{{13}}. The sweetness in it is the sweetness you put there — and it grows sweeter exactly in proportion to what you bring. So the feeling you were waiting for was never going to arrive first. It arrives second.

essay.mr: कृति तीन शब्दांची आहे. नाम घ्यावें, तें आपणच आपल्या कानांनीं ऐकावें, आणि तें घेतां घेतां त्यांत स्वतःला विसरून जावें{{18}}. एवढेंच सांगितलें आहे — आणि इथें कान मागितले आहेत, एकाग्रता नव्हे. तें आपल्याला ऐकूं येईल इतकें असावें.
essay.en: The method is three words long. Say it. Hear it with your own ears. Go on until you forget yourself in it.{{18}} That is the whole instruction — and note that it asks for your ears, not your concentration. It is meant to be audible to you.

essay.mr: असें पुष्कळ वेळां घडलें कीं तें करण्याची क्रिया राहत नाहीं. पाणी जसें शरीराचें जीवन, तसें नाम मनाचें जीवन बनलें पाहिजे{{21}} — सकाळीं करावयाची गोष्ट नव्हे; ज्यांत राहावयाचें तें.
essay.en: Do that often enough and it stops being an activity you perform. Water is the life of the body; the Name is to become the life of the mind{{21}}. Not something done in the morning. Something lived in.

essay.mr: आणि शेवटीं तें कठीण पण स्पष्ट वाक्य — जें जें सुटत जातें त्यांत अगदीं शेवटीं सुटणारी वस्तु म्हणजे भगवंताचें नाम पाहिजे{{22}}.
essay.en: And then the plain, difficult ending the page builds toward: of everything that falls away at the end, let this be the last to go{{22}}.

essay.mr: म्हणून सुरुवात कधीं करावी, हा प्रश्नच उरत नाहीं. शेवटचा श्वास नामांत जावयाचा असेल, तर आजचा प्रत्येक जप त्याचीच तयारी आहे. नंतर सुरू होणारी अशी ही साधना नाहीं.
essay.en: Which settles the question of when to begin. If the last breath is to go out in the Name, then every repetition made today is the rehearsal for it. There is no version of this practice that starts later.

steps.en: Say the Name — once, aloud and quietly.
Hear it in your own ears. Audible to you.

steps.mr: घेतां घेतां त्यांत स्वतःला विसरून जावें.
steps.en: Stay with it until you forget yourself in it.

begin_today.close_mr: तयारी कांहीं नाहीं, शिकावें कांहीं नाहीं, ठराविक जागाहि नाहीं. गोडी आपण घालायची; चव मागून येते.
begin_today.close_en: Nothing to prepare, nothing to learn, no place you must be. You supply the liking; the sweetness follows.

practice_actions.today: Say it once aloud, quietly, so that your own ears hear it. Not silently — audibly enough to be heard by you.
Do not wait to feel anything. Bring the liking with you; the sweetness is what you put in, not what you find.
Take it into ordinary work — walking, cooking, waiting — not only into the time you set aside.
Keep whatever else you already do. Add this; do not exchange it for this.
Return to it as often as you drink water today. Frequency, not duration.
Let it be the last thing before sleep, as a rehearsal of the last thing before the end.
Choose one ordinary task today and do that one task in remembrance.
